**Re-split C2 into C2a / C2-migrate / C2b after review fixes hit 476/400**

What: The C2 memory-format slice was re-split after the adversarial-review fixes (BLOCKER-1 state-machine rewrite + MAJOR-2/3 buckets) pushed the counted diff to 476/400.

Why: Plan §10 mandates split-not-`size:exception`. Human ruling approved the re-split.

Split (all on feature/v2.0.0, feature-branch-chain):
- C2a (#217, PR #218) = provenance.mjs (§4 parse/render pair) + engram-export.mjs only → 251/400. Reviewed against §4 fixtures = a CONTRACT verdict. 982 tests on-branch (pre-split combined was 994).
- C2-migrate = migrate-v1 report + CLI dry-run op + real-data dry-run. Needs its OWN status:approved issue per §0.1 (one approved issue per slice — NO exception for a split). Code parked on LOCAL branch wip/c2-migrate (two commits: the C2a commit as base + the migrate chore commit). NOT pushed. Reviewed against the 278 real observations = an APPLICATION verdict.
- C2b (unchanged) = import (renderProvenance) + scrub re-point to records/ + real persisting run + dual-write pipeline. Follows C2-migrate.

Where: brain/scripts/memory/lib/{provenance,engram-export}.mjs (C2a); {migrate-v1}.mjs + cli.mjs + i18n + package.json (wip/c2-migrate). openspec/changes/issue-217-*/{design,tasks,checkpoint-report}.md carry the re-split note.

Learned: A review-driven fix can push an already-approved slice over budget — re-split at the checkpoint, never size:exception. Two verdicts (contract vs application) are cleaner separated than bundled.
